name: interface-craft-cards

frames.best_why: The blue card is enlarged and centred with its description shown, while the others fall behind.

tagline: Fanned stack of tilted colour cards that springs one forward when clicked.
summary: Five coloured cards lie in a loose tilted fan. Clicking one straightens it, scales it up and brings it to the middle with a short description, while the others shrink and drop away; a click outside restores the fan.
appearance: Five tall rounded cards in orange, off-white, blue, purple and near-black, spread in a shallow overlapping fan on black. Each has a soft gradient block across the top and a white title near its lower edge; the chosen card sits upright and larger with a paragraph beneath its title.
behaviour: At rest the cards lean at small angles with staggered heights. Clicking a card rotates it upright, enlarges it and slides it to centre while the rest scale down and fall behind; clicking anywhere outside springs everything back to the fan.
demo_content: Five competency cards: Working Knowledge, Practical Demonstration, Collaborate with AI, Means & Methods, Interface Kit.
search_phrases: fan of cards you can click
pick a card and it comes forward
tilted cards spread out on screen
colourful cards that enlarge on click
show details when a card is chosen
use_when: A few peer options or topics should be browsable as a playful stack instead of a plain list.
avoid_when: Overlapping cards cut off their own titles, and the wide fan needs a large centred area to sit in.
customise: Spring feel, active scale and card spacing are props; the five cards, their titles, descriptions and colours are written into the array.
weight_why: Five cards using spring and layout transforms that only run during a change.

a11y.note: Cards are buttons and can be tabbed to, but there is no focus ring, no Escape to close, and reduced-motion is never checked.

issues: In the fanned state the overlapping cards clip each other's titles.
There is no visible focus ring and no Escape key to dismiss the open card.
polish_why: Bold colours and a satisfying springy reveal; clipped titles and missing focus cues cost it.
